endovla-oov.lead: Finding a target starts before it enters the frame.
endovla-oov.overview: An instruction identifies the region to revisit. Initial, intermediate and current images help the policy search through partial observations, producing continuous commands for the two distal bending axes.
endovla-oov.result_note: Acquisition result: full-data policy on a second robotic embodiment in an unseen ex-vivo environment. Acquisition and precise centering are evaluated separately.

steps.text: Language specifies appearance and an anatomical region.

steps.title: Use visual context
steps.text: Earlier and current observations guide search beyond the present view.

steps.title: Act continuously
steps.text: The adapted policy predicts chunks of two-axis bending commands.

ebv-can.lead: Navigate locally. Keep the global goal in sight.
ebv-can.overview: One initial bird’s-eye image provides a fixed spatial reference. Endoscopic observations and motor state update three grounded queries—tip, waypoint and target—to guide bending and insertion through environmental contact.
ebv-can.result_note: Physical success uses automatic blue-area scoring on the planar contact-aided navigation platform.

steps.title: Remember the scene
steps.text: Cache the initial bird’s-eye image as a shared spatial reference.

steps.title: Ground the instruction
steps.text: Estimate the tip, next waypoint and requested target.

steps.title: Navigate with contact
steps.text: Translate grounded representations into bending and insertion commands.

ebv-can.method_caption: Cached global features meet evolving local observations and semantic queries. Figure 4 of the preprint.

ebv-can.result_caption: Selected successful multi-guide and target-conditioned executions. Figure 9 of the preprint.

endorsi.lead: Every experiment informs what to try next.
endorsi.overview: A coding agent analyses experiments and revises candidate policies. Human-authorised trials run in a separate safety-constrained runtime, and physical outcomes feed back into the next research cycle.
endorsi.result_note: Insertion improves from 2/21 in generation 1 to 17/21 in generation 4. The final frozen policy is evaluated separately for transfer.

steps.text: An isolated runtime executes the authorised experiment.

steps.title: Learn from outcomes
steps.text: Failures and feedback shape the next policy revision.
